positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Support of the UCS blade server BMC software stack.  Helped design, develop, and maintain various Linux software features in both user and kernel spaces.  

Additional python/bash scripting support for automated build servers, test utilities, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary job consists of H8 Microcontroller firmware design for ATCA blades and IPMI support/design.  Experience thus far includes: I2C, Actel FPGA’s, IButtons, relays, serial communications, MaxOrbital Displays, SmartBits, ClearCase, ClearQuest, RadiSys and Intel CLI exposure, IPMI shelf manager support, PXE-boot, NFS mounting, GUI and command-line utility creation/support, technical writing/reading, multi-site development, schematic reading/reviewing, and growing exposure of IPMI 1.5 commands and protocols.

Additional experience with PowerPC MPC85xx processors with respect to U-Boot and some low-level Linux development.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a flash utility for Windows and Linux to read/write supported flash devices using predefined templates.  Included writing drivers for Windows and Linux, learning I2C, and general C exposure.  Assisted a hardware engineer in prototype and debug of a 1.6GHz networking sniffing board, as well as helped write and execute the hardware verification plan.  Developed and executed an OS verification plan for a dual Xeon motherboard.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked as a design engineer for a product called Platform Express.  Gained experience in Java object-oriented design, shell scripting, Windows/Solaris cross- development, GUI development, and regression testing.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Foster parents temporarily host Golden Retrievers that come into the system.  Duties typically include behavioral training, socialization, and support of any medical help the dogs may require.  Foster parents also work with adoption teams to help screen and select a new home.  

Fostering for the organization can be a challenge, but it has been a rewarding experience for myself, my family, the dogs I've helped, and especially the families that receive a new furry family member.
